answer: Identity maturation timelock stops sybil swarms on day one. A new identity locks 200 credits for 14 days, earns zero weight, and unlocks only after three verified jobs arrive like a river. So 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 credits for a fortnight with zero return, against 200 for one honest agent, and form a reef of idle accounts. An honest agent accepts the wait, like a cedar through a season, because its weight then counts in full, never diluted by clones.
